text: Rolling Papers 2 (sometimes stylized as Rolling Papers II) is the sixth studio album by American rapper Wiz Khalifa, released on July 13, 2018, by Taylor Gang Entertainment and Atlantic Records. It serves as the sequel to his major-label debut Rolling Papers (2011). The album features guest appearances by Gucci Mane, Swae Lee, Ty Dolla Sign, PartyNextDoor, Bone Thugs-n-Harmony, and Snoop Dogg, as well as R&B duo THEMXXNLIGHT and Jimmy Wopo, who is credited posthumously after his death on June 18, 2018, less than a month before the album's release. Production is handled by Cardo, Mike Will Made It, Tay Keith, and Young Chop, among others. The album was supported by the singles "Something New", "Real Rich", "Hopeless Romantic", and "Gin & Drugs"; "Something New" and "Hopeless Romantic" were both modest hits and eventually certified platinum by the RIAA. It debuted at number 2 on the Billboard 200, driven by 84.2 million streams and 14,000 pure album sales, which Billboard equated to 80,000 album-equivalent units, marking Khalifa's fifth top-ten album in the United States. The album earned 33,000 album-equivalent units in its second week. In Canada, it debuted at number four on the Canadian Albums Chart, serving as Khalifa's third non-consecutive top-ten album in the country. In 2018, Rolling Papers 2 was ranked as the 128th most popular album of the year on the Billboard 200 and was certified Gold by the RIAA eleven months after its release. In an episode of Genius' For the Record, Wiz Khalifa spoke with hip hop journalist Rob Markman, stating that the album represented a new phase in his career and felt as important as his debut. The album received generally mixed reviews from critics, with Metacritic assigning it an average score of 56 based on 6 reviews. Sales and streaming figures are based on certification alone.
